timeline.summary: Raymond Realty uploaded the audio recording of its investor conference for Q4 and FY26 results on May 6, 2026.
On May 12, 2026, Raymond Realty received BSE and NSE in-principle approval for issue, allotment and listing of 13,80,588 equity shares under the Raymond Realty Employees Stock Option Plan 2025.
Raymond Realty hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 6, 2026, highlighting a 29% rise in annual total income.
Raymond Realty incorporated Ten X Realty South Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on May 15, 2026.
Raymond Realty submitted clarifications to NSE regarding the EGM notice for preferential issue and warrant allocation.
Raymond Realty Limited schedules conference call on October 28, 2026, at 11:30 AM (IST) to discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance.
Raymond Realty obtained in-principle stock exchange approval for preferential issue of 66,57,373 convertible warrants to promoters.
On October 26, 2026, Raymond Realty announced that subsidiary Ten X Realty West agreed to raise ₹210 Cr from ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹748.52 Cr; net profit ₹53.06 Cr (-11.8% YoY).
Raymond Realty reported Q2FY27 pre-sales of ₹902 Cr, up 98% YoY, and total income of ₹757 Cr.
On October 28, 2026, joint statutory auditor Chaturvedi & Shah LLP resigned due to a fee dispute, leaving Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP as continuing auditor.
